question: Why does the in-guest LiteInst flagship fail the authoritative liteinst_strict_verify_virtual_identity_and_time gate (date +%s returns host wall-clock instead of the deterministic epoch)?
answer: The in-guest Tool DOES determinize the raw clock_gettime syscall (raw=epoch), but the glibc vDSO fast path leaks host wall-clock (vdso=host). reverie-ptrace vdso_patch (which rewrites vDSO time symbols to real syscalls) is effective under a full-Tool ptrace supervisor but NOT under the in-guest TracerBuilder::<()> lifecycle supervisor. Bounded determinism bug, NOT owner-gated/structural (refutes prior memory note). Blocks the entire flagship stack (#1429->#1443->#1466) from landing.
key_source: reverie-ptrace/src/vdso.rs:247 vdso_patch (rewrites __vdso_clock_gettime etc to mov+syscall+ret stubs)
reverie-ptrace/src/task.rs:1757 vdso_patch called UNGATED in tracee_preinit
reverie-preload/src/seccomp.rs for_trusted_gate: traps every syscall by IP except trusted gate; vDSO fast path makes NO syscall so is uncovered unless vdso_patch redirects it
